Copyright Tono Laboratory, TUFS. Modified: normalized, merged POS, removed multiword headwords; first slash spelling retained.
Octanove Vocabulary Profile C1/C2 1.0, Octanove Labs. Modified: normalized, merged POS, removed multiword headwords; first slash spelling retained. Adapted data distributed under CC BY-SA 4.0.
Open English WordNet Team, Open English WordNet 2025. Modified: single-word normalized lemmas, maximum two definitions per POS. Includes Princeton WordNet material; see notices.

Carnegie Mellon University, CMU Pronouncing Dictionary. Modified: ARPAbet converted to broad US IPA, first pronunciation retained. CMUdict does not label POS; alternate numbered pronunciations are not POS labels.
Open English WordNet Team, 2025. US-labelled pronunciations only, grouped by POS; fallback where CMUdict has no entry.
WordNet irregular exception lists and Morphy suffix rules; normalized and removed multiword forms. Princeton University WordNet notice retained in notices.

VOKA-generated Simplified Chinese native glosses derived from Open English WordNet 2025 (CC BY 4.0; includes Princeton WordNet material). Generated with model(s) deepseek/deepseek-flash, gpt-6-luna (effort max) through Codex/OpenCode CLI on 2026-10-31; prompt SHA-256 56cf4d1e5d64dc904dc4aab3ee42784a55da63cd365ec9581e22629ee0749a9b. Modifications: generated per single-word OEWN lemma, grouped by OEWN POS, at most three senses per POS and at most ten Han characters per sense. Chinese text is VOKA's own; no ECDICT or Wiktionary data is included.
